BAY PROCEDURE Tacoma RV Center · Document Library CONCERN FCR10 E2 fan fault current on the freezer evaporator fan MODEL Furrion FCR10 DATE 2026-10-09 WO# - PRIMARY Furrion fridge service manual, Fan Fault Diagnostics, page 27. VISUAL FLOWCHART E2 or fan fault on this fridge. Nominal 12V at F+ and F-? Replace the inverter PCB and the fan. Check fan connections, then reset power. Did the error go away? Replace the inverter PCB and the fan. That is the confirmed correction. YES NO YES NO BAY PROCEDURE Bay order · Tacoma RV Center WHAT THIS PATTERN USUALLY MEANS An E2 or fan-fault code on this fridge is the fan-fault diagnostics path. Measure about 12V at F+ and F- on the inverter PCB. No voltage means replace the inverter PCB and the fan. Voltage present with the error still on after the connection check means replace the inverter PCB and the fan. BAY ORDER (START HERE) Step 1: Connect power and locate the inverter PCB Do this: 1. Measure voltage at the F+ and F- terminals. 2. Is the nominal voltage about 12V? 3. If no, replace the inverter PCB and the fan. 4. That is the confirmed correction for a dead fan-voltage reading. 5. If yes, go to the connection check. Step 2: Check the fan connection at the inverter PCB F+ and F- terminals and the fan quick connection Do this: 1. Reset power. 2. Did the error code go away? 3. If yes, that is the confirmed correction. Step 3: Replace the inverter PCB and the fan Do this: 1. Do this when the error stays after the checks and reset. 2. That is the confirmed correction. DO NOT - Do not treat this E2 as a rooftop air-conditioner code. - Do not replace only the board when fan voltage is present and the error remains.
